Description: Buyer opens an order to see details.
Buyer can cancel a pending order.
A shipped order cannot be cancelled.
Buyer can reorder products from a past order.
Buyer can contact the seller from the order page.
Buyer sees when an order is delivered.
Buyer can check out items from more than one seller.
The system splits a parent order into seller sub-orders.
A seller sees only their own sub-order.
Buyer sees the full combined order.
Buyer sees a partial shipment when one seller ships first.
Admin can view the full order with all sub-orders.
